statement: A source-transparent history of Swiss prosperity: how it is produced, shared, financed and sustained, and how institutions, international developments and crises change it.

modules.title: Output and productivity
modules.question: How much prosperity comes from productivity, labour and capital accumulation?

families.title: GDP levels and growth
families.annual_view: Annual nominal and real output, with published growth and reconstruction breaks.
families.next_step: Maintain the verified GDP foundation; quarterly episode analysis is a later extension.

families.title: Real GDP per capita
families.annual_view: Real GDP divided by the documented population denominator.
families.next_step: Retain the explicit year-end population convention and inherited national-accounts breaks.

families.title: Output per hour worked
families.annual_view: FSO-published annual real output per actual hour worked, index 1991=100; 1991–2025, with compatible WPS hours and source revision flags.
families.next_step: Maintain matched output/hours vintages, 2023–2025 revised flags and the documented pre-2010 hours harmonisation. Do not substitute nominal productivity or per-worker output.

families.title: Investment relative to GDP
families.annual_view: Annual investment flows divided by compatible nominal GDP.
families.next_step: Select business and construction investment with matching accounting coverage.

modules.title: Population and labour
modules.question: How do population change, migration, participation and employment affect prosperity?

families.title: Population
families.annual_view: Published year-end permanent resident population.
families.next_step: Maintain population definitions and census/register transitions.

families.title: Net migration and cross-border workers
families.annual_view: Annual migration flows; separately defined annual worker stocks or means.
families.next_step: Audit migration balance and cross-border employment without merging residence concepts.

families.title: Employment and labour-force participation
families.annual_view: Annual employment, employment rates and participation with explicit age bases.
families.next_step: Distinguish people, jobs and full-time equivalents; preserve survey breaks.

families.title: Total hours worked
families.annual_view: FSO WPS annual total actual hours worked in millions; 1991–2025. Reconciled to the hourly-productivity denominator, including harmonised pre-2010 history.
families.next_step: Maintain the source workbook, matching WPS index and revision lineage. Preserve total-hours units and do not splice unadjusted WV history or replace totals with hours per person/job.

families.title: Registered and ILO unemployment
families.annual_view: Complete-year SECO means and separately published BFS / ILO annual estimates.
families.next_step: Maintain both definitions; extend historical coverage only with verified annual evidence.

families.title: Age structure and dependency ratios
families.annual_view: Annual population shares and dependency ratios with explicit age thresholds.
families.next_step: Connect demographic change with labour supply and social-insurance financing.

modules.title: Purchasing power and household income
modules.question: How do gains in output translate into households' material circumstances?

families.title: Consumer prices and inflation
families.annual_view: Published annual inflation; the native monthly CPI remains separately available.
families.next_step: Maintain the verified price and inflation definitions; extend history only after source review.

families.title: Nominal and real wages
families.annual_view: Annual wage indices and real wage growth using a named consumer-price basis.
families.next_step: Prioritise the FSO wage index; keep wage growth distinct from median salary levels.

families.title: Real median disposable household income
families.annual_view: Annual real equivalised median income, with the equivalence scale and deflator stated.
families.next_step: Audit household survey coverage, income reference year and breaks; accept a shorter reliable history.

families.title: Real consumption per person
families.annual_view: Annual real household consumption divided by a compatible population denominator.
families.next_step: Document national-accounts versus household-survey coverage before comparing with income.

modules.title: Money and monetary policy
modules.question: How do policy regimes, liquidity and borrowing costs change over time?

families.title: Historically appropriate policy instruments
families.annual_view: Instrument-specific year-end readings or documented annual means.
families.next_step: Preserve separate discount, Lombard, Libor-target and modern policy-rate identities.

families.title: Short-term market rates, including SARON
families.annual_view: A documented annual average of the chosen market rate.
families.next_step: Audit SARON access and reuse terms; retain its own starting date rather than splice earlier instruments.

families.title: Government yields and the yield spread
families.annual_view: Documented annual yield averages and matched-year spreads; native sources stay separate.
families.next_step: Annual GMBF is available. Individual three-month auction events are lower-priority work pending source verification.

families.title: Broad money, M2 / M3
families.annual_view: Year-end money stocks and compatible GDP ratios, with aggregate definitions.
families.next_step: Choose a broad-money baseline and document changes in monetary aggregates.

families.title: SNB balance sheet and reserves
families.annual_view: Year-end balance-sheet and foreign-reserve stocks, with valuation conventions.
families.next_step: Connect interventions and liquidity with exchange-rate regimes; distinguish flows from valuation effects.

modules.title: The franc and international integration
modules.question: How do foreign demand, capital flows and monetary conditions shape Switzerland?

families.title: CHF bilateral exchange rates
families.annual_view: Annual means in CHF per foreign currency: EUR 1999–2025, USD 1971–2025 and historical DEM 1950–1998. Lower values mean franc appreciation; fixing conventions differ.
families.next_step: Maintain the verified ECB, Federal Reserve and Bundesbank sources. Preserve CHF/DEM before 1999 as a separate history, not a synthetic pre-1999 euro.

families.title: Nominal and real effective exchange rates
families.annual_view: SNB-published annual mean overall indices, 1973–2025; 2000=100, real index CPI-based. Higher values mean appreciation. The country pool changes in 2000.
families.next_step: Maintain the SNB methodology, weight/price-input revision notes and non-commercial attribution conditions. No partial 2026 annual values.

families.title: Exports, imports and trade balance
families.annual_view: Annual trade flows and balances; compatible GDP shares where appropriate.
families.next_step: Specify customs goods coverage and gold/valuables treatment; keep national-accounts goods and services distinct.

families.title: Current-account balance
families.annual_view: Annual balance-of-payments flows and a matching nominal-GDP ratio.
families.next_step: Audit SNB balance-of-payments revisions and explain the difference from the goods trade balance.

families.title: International investment position
families.annual_view: Year-end foreign assets and liabilities, with valuation and coverage notes.
families.next_step: Add after external flows; distinguish the net position from transaction-driven capital flows.

modules.title: Credit, housing and banking
modules.question: Where do financial exposures accumulate, and how do they affect housing and banking?

families.title: Private credit relative to GDP
families.annual_view: Year-end credit stocks divided by compatible annual nominal GDP.
families.next_step: Audit bank versus total credit and household versus corporate coverage before assembling a history.

families.title: Mortgage lending and mortgage debt
families.annual_view: Year-end mortgage stocks and explicitly defined debt ratios.
families.next_step: Connect financing volumes with property prices; document institutional and borrower coverage.

families.title: Real residential property prices
families.annual_view: Annual mean price index deflated by a named CPI, with property coverage.
families.next_step: Prefer an auditable national series; keep new statistical indices and historical reconstructions distinct.

families.title: Mortgage borrowing costs and rental reference rate
families.annual_view: Separate annual views for new lending, outstanding mortgages and the official rental reference rate.
families.next_step: Audit SNB and BWO definitions and aggregation; the rounded rental reference rate is a distinct measure.

families.title: Rents, housing supply and vacancies
families.annual_view: Annual rent indices, construction flows and vacancy readings with their survey dates.
families.next_step: Relate housing costs to wages and income without treating a vacancy-date reading as an annual mean.

families.title: Selected bank balance-sheet measures
families.annual_view: Annual bank capital and funding measures at a documented consolidation level.
families.next_step: Select a small crisis-relevant set; preserve changes in bank populations and accounting standards.

modules.title: Government and public finances
modules.question: How do fiscal capacity, the state's role and responses to shocks evolve?

families.title: Government revenue and tax burden
families.annual_view: Annual revenue and tax-to-GDP ratios with consistent government coverage.
families.next_step: Audit FFA totals, social-insurance coverage and matching GDP denominators.

families.title: Government expenditure
families.annual_view: Annual expenditure flows and matching GDP shares.
families.next_step: Keep consolidated general government separate from Confederation, cantonal and municipal totals.

families.title: Fiscal balance
families.annual_view: Annual surplus / deficit and GDP ratio under a named accounting framework.
families.next_step: Distinguish financing balances from national-accounts net lending; connect to documented fiscal rules.

families.title: Public debt levels and debt / GDP
families.annual_view: Year-end debt stocks and defined GDP ratios, preserving sector and source breaks.
families.next_step: Maintain separate general-government and Confederation measures, and explicit forecasts.

families.title: Composition of government expenditure
families.annual_view: Annual functional spending shares and selected interest costs.
families.next_step: Add education, social protection and interest burdens once comparable fiscal totals are established.

modules.title: Distribution and social protection
modules.question: Who participates in prosperity, and how much economic security do households have?

families.title: Disposable-income inequality
families.annual_view: Annual inequality statistics for a documented income concept and population.
families.next_step: Choose a disposable-income measure and preserve survey and equivalence-scale changes.

families.title: Poverty and material deprivation
families.annual_view: Published annual poverty rates with thresholds and income reference years.
families.next_step: Distinguish absolute, relative and material-deprivation concepts rather than merge them.

families.title: Income and wealth concentration
families.annual_view: Annual top shares where survey or tax data support a defensible comparison.
families.next_step: Document tax-unit, pension-wealth and valuation exclusions before interpreting changes.

families.title: Social-protection expenditure
families.annual_view: Annual benefit expenditure and compatible GDP shares.
families.next_step: Distinguish programmes and financing systems; link reforms as separately sourced events.

modules.title: Structural transformation and resources
modules.question: How do productive capabilities, sectors and resource requirements change?

families.title: Sectoral employment and value-added shares
families.annual_view: Annual sector shares using documented industry classifications.
families.next_step: Connect industrialisation and services with employment and productivity; mark classification breaks.

families.title: Education and skills
families.annual_view: Selected annual attainment, training or research measures with population bases.
families.next_step: Prioritise measures that explain productive capacity; preserve changes in qualification systems.

families.title: Energy use, import dependence and emissions intensity
families.annual_view: Annual resource flows and compatible output or population intensities.
families.next_step: State energy accounting and emissions boundaries; connect resource constraints to prosperity.

families.title: Selected infrastructure measures
families.annual_view: Annual transport or communications stocks and use, selected for a historical question.
families.next_step: Add a small set only when comparable evidence explains productive or regional change.

modules.title: Saving, wealth and investment returns
modules.question: How do saving, accumulated wealth and returns develop alongside wages and production?

families.title: Broad Swiss equity total returns
families.annual_view: Calendar-year total return, distinguishing dividends from price return.
families.next_step: Prioritise one representative broad series such as SPI total return after the core gaps. Exact SMI / SMIC candidates remain subject to SIX permission; verify SPI terms independently.

families.title: Government bond total returns
families.annual_view: Annual holding-period total return, including coupons and price changes.
families.next_step: Select a documented maturity portfolio; a yield is not a bond total return.

families.title: Household saving, assets and debt
families.annual_view: Annual saving flows and year-end asset / liability stocks with coverage notes.
families.next_step: Distinguish saving from capital gains and state whether pension entitlements are included.

families.title: Pension-system assets and returns
families.annual_view: Year-end pension assets and separately defined annual investment returns.
families.next_step: Add after wages, housing and core credit; preserve second-pillar institutional coverage.

acquisition_order.title: Wages and household purchasing power
acquisition_order.why: Connect national prosperity with the material circumstances of households.

acquisition_order.title: Housing and its financing
acquisition_order.why: Connect borrowing costs and credit exposures with property prices and household burdens.

acquisition_order.title: Trade and the current account
acquisition_order.why: Connect domestic activity and the franc with foreign demand and external balances.

acquisition_order.title: Fiscal revenue, expenditure and balance
acquisition_order.why: Give the existing debt history its fiscal-flow and institutional context.

deferred_series.next_step: Establish reuse terms for the FFA auction workbook and verify three-month tranche selection, event dates and multiple auctions. The published annual GMBF average already supports annual comparisons.
Obtain an authorised historical SMI price-index export with permission for public display and downloads.
Obtain an authorised historical SMIC total-return export with permission for public display and downloads.
Verify year-end trading closes and permission to publish derived annual price returns.
Verify matching year-end trading closes and permission to publish derived annual total returns.
